name: Newsroom AI Assistant
author: koskar22

sections.description:
WordPress is now a newsroom operating system.

Welcome to Newsroom AI Assistant (by newsos.io). We transform your standard WordPress editor into a complete newsroom command center. Discover what matters in real-time, connect stories automatically, and publish faster.

⚡ Built & tested on real high-traffic news websites. Designed for real editorial teams, not just bloggers.

🔥 What’s inside the Newsroom OS?

1. Trend Radar (No Algorithmic Bias)
See what the world is searching and publishing in real-time. Break out of algorithmic bubbles and spot stories before they go viral.
* Live Google Trends: What people are searching right now.
* Unfiltered Google News: What publishers are actually writing.
* See the real news, not what algorithms want you to see.

2. Story Cluster Engine (Automatic Timelines)
Turn every article into a content hub. With one click, automatically generate a vertical story timeline based on the article’s tags or keywords. Build powerful internal linking structures and boost your SEO with zero effort.

3. Smart Internal Linking
Insert relevant articles in seconds. Search via keyword, select multiple articles via checkboxes, and insert them as a styled “Read Also” block instantly. No more manual linking. No more wasted time.

4. Newsroom Command Center
Plan, assign, and execute your content strategy from one place.
* Assign tasks and stories to journalists.
* Set deadlines, recurrence, and “lead days” warnings.
* Visual URGENT indicators for upcoming stories.
* Monitor Live Trends directly from your admin dashboard.

5. AI Assistant Prompts
Built-in, perfectly engineered prompts ready to be copied to your favorite AI (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude). Generate SEO headlines, article structures, meta descriptions, and FAQs instantly.

🚀 What’s next?

We’re just getting started. Visit newsos.io to learn more about our upcoming PRO version featuring direct API integration, auto article generation, and advanced SEO tools.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/newsroom-ai-assistant directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new “AI Assistant” menu in your WordPress dashboard to configure your settings and start assigning stories.
  4. Open any post to see the new Newsroom OS sidebar in action!
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

Major Update – Introducing the Newsroom OS!
* 🆕 New Feature: 🔥 Trend Radar. Live Google Trends and Unfiltered Google News directly inside your editor.
* 🆕 New Feature: ⏳ Story Cluster Engine. Automatically generate a story timeline based on article tags or keywords.
* 🚀 Improvement: 🧠 Smart Internal Linking. Insert related articles faster using a new checkbox-based system.
* 🧑‍💼 Workflow Upgrade: 🧭 Command Center Layout. Redesigned admin panel with a dual-column layout (Tasks + Trends).
* 🧑‍💼 Workflow Upgrade: ✏️ Edit Tasks Functionality. You can now edit existing editorial tasks directly.
* 🎨 UI/UX: New custom SVG icon for a professional look.
* 🎨 UI/UX: Updated labels (Trend Radar, Smart Internal Linking, AI Assistant) and enhanced empty states.
* 🛠 Fixes: Fixed minor UI issues in the admin panel and improved the AJAX response for News & Trends.

1.0.0

  • Initial Release.
